title: Vaultwarden Admin Token Age
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vaultwarden:event event=admin_token
| stats latest(rotation_age_days) as rotation_age_days by instance
| where rotation_age_days>30
| sort - rotation_age_days
description: Uses Vaultwarden admin-token events telemetry to monitor how long the admin token has gone without rotation in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for instances drifting beyond a comfortable secret-rotation age, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Vaultwarden admin-token events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long the admin token has gone without rotation so you can spot instances drifting beyond a comfortable secret-rotation age before it becomes annoying.
